summary: Round 28 plan check (19:36-20:00Z 28 Sep). findings.what: The no-freeze fallback exists only inside the freeze line it is meant to replace. R27-A4 (7)(a) says: if no freeze line was logged, compute 51's code from poll headers stamped <= 23:30Z only; with no COMPLETE header, STACK = exp89q; a later read never changes the variant. But (7)(a) is written as part of the 23:30Z freeze text, and that freeze depends on a cron that does not fire (PC28-01). A batch run woken at 00:04Z, or a backup at 00:20-01:30Z, would find neither the freeze line nor this rule in CONTEXT, and could pick the stack after seeing a later read (post-hoc). A second gap: W4 AMEND 4 keeps AMEND 3's '23:30Z dummy-PASS deadline' without saying whether it covers morning files. If 51 reads late or the wake slips, the exp89l dummy could PASS after 23:30Z, and a strict reading would then drop A-M1.

A header or read after 23:30Z never changes the variant. Scope of the 23:30Z dummy-PASS deadline: night files only. A morning file needs its dummy PASSED before its decision header (A-M1 latest 08:40Z, B-M1 10:30Z, M2 11:00Z).' The freeze line must carry the literal header 'W4 FREEZE: NIGHT 29 Sep', because R27N-3 G4 greps that exact string and a count of 0 blocks the batch.
